title: New category
purpose: Add a category inside a group, with its default team and priority, whether clients may raise it, and its complaint and restricted rules.
summary: Add a category tickets can be filed under. Choose its group, name it and set how new tickets in it are routed. Only the admin role can open this form.

tasks.title: Add a category
steps: Choose the [[Group]] and enter the [[Category name]].
Set [[Default team]] and [[Default priority]] if the defaults do not fit.
Select [[Create category]]. The list opens at the group.

tasks.title: Let clients raise a category
steps: Tick [[Clients may raise it in the portal]] and save.
Add a [[Client label]] if clients should see different wording.

tasks.title: Mark a category as a complaint or restricted
steps: Tick [[Complaint: tickets follow the complaint rules]] or [[Restricted: visible only to the team's members and supervisors]].

good_to_know: The key is a stable code. It cannot be changed after the category is created, so choose it with care or leave it empty.
A category name must be unique within its group, ignoring capital letters.
Only active groups are offered, and a category sits in a group, never in another category.
Changing the complaint or restricted rule later needs a reason and is recorded as its own kind of change.

items.label: Group
items.description: Required. One of the active groups, in list order. When you came from Add category on a group, that group is chosen. A category can only be in a group, which has no group of its own.

items.label: Category name
items.description: Required, up to 120 characters. What staff see. Unique within the group, ignoring case; surrounding spaces are removed.

items.label: Key
items.description: Optional, letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores, up to 60 characters. Leave empty to make one from the name. It must be unused by any other category or group. Presets and reports find a category by its key, so it never changes after creation.

items.label: Client label
items.description: Optional, up to 120 characters. The wording for client portal users. Empty means the staff name is used.

items.label: Intake guidance
items.description: Optional text kept with the category for staff who log a ticket in it.

items.label: Default team
items.description: Optional, an active team. Empty means the laboratory's default team. Proposed for new tickets in this category.

items.label: Default priority
items.description: Low, Normal, High or Urgent; Normal unless changed. Used for a new ticket in this category when none is given.

items.label: Clients may raise it in the portal
items.description: Off by default. When off, the category is staff only and a portal account cannot file a ticket in it.

items.label: Complaint: tickets follow the complaint rules
items.description: Off by default. Tickets created in the category are marked as complaints.

items.label: Restricted: visible only to the team's members and supervisors
items.description: Off by default. Tickets in the category are visible only to members of their team and to supervisors.

items.label: Create category
items.description: Saves the category at the end of its group and records who created it. The list opens at the group with a confirmation. A new category is active; there is no Active or reason field on creation.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to Ticket categories without saving.

items.label: Refusals
items.description: A key already in use, a name already in the group, or an inactive team is refused with a message beside the field, and what you typed stays.
